race.description: Tab One Pool Colts, Geldings & Entires Hcp (Bm58)
race.comment: SMASHING NOVA (10) gets the nod despite two recent midfield efforts because the set-up looks far more suitable back to 1200m. The form around him reads strongly with plenty of subsequent winners, he can become one this time. LA PROFECIA (6) is the main threat after finishing third at this track as favourite when awkward away and forced wide on the home turn. He is proven at the trip. SUM INVICTUS (11) has mixed his form this prep but boasts peaks that stack up. Inside pillar helps. TORQUE SO HOT (12) forgive the last run when finishing seventh in a Class 1 at Coffs Harbour. His Grafton third on soft ground reads well and he can feature here.
